from pathlib import Path
import json,subprocess,time
s=Path('/home/claude/.scratch/eka-benchmark');r=Path('/home/claude/code/EKA2L1');state=s/'tail-prefix-replay-state.json'
def phase(name,**kw):
 state.write_text(json.dumps(dict(phase=name,utc=time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ',time.gmtime()),**kw),indent=2)+'\n');print(name,kw,flush=True)
def run(script,log):
 with(s/log).open('w')as f:subprocess.run(['python3',str(s/script)],cwd=r,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
try:
 phase('waiting_for_site_diagnostics')
 while True:
  a=json.loads((s/'conditional-site-finish-state.json').read_text());b=json.loads((s/'conditional-site-module-state.json').read_text())
  if a['phase']=='failure' or b['phase']=='failure':raise RuntimeError('Prior site diagnostics failed; replay held')
  if a['phase']=='census_complete_pending_record' and b['phase']=='modules_complete':break
  time.sleep(5)
 phase('recording_site_diagnostics')
 run('record_conditional_site_census.py','conditional-site-census-record.log')
 run('record_conditional_site_modules.py','conditional-site-module-record.log')
 run('finalize_conditional_site.py','conditional-site-finalize.log')
 phase('waiting_for_tail_acceptance')
 while True:
  unit=(s/'tail-prefix-full-suite.log').read_text();fault=(s/'tail-prefix-fault-acceptance.log').read_text()
  if 'Traceback (most recent call last)' in fault or '\n FAIL ' in unit:raise RuntimeError('Tail acceptance failed; replay held')
  if '173 passed, 0 failed' in unit and 'tail-prefix-fault-candidate.log PASS' in fault:break
  time.sleep(5)
 phase('replay')
 with(s/'tail-prefix-replay-acceptance.log').open('w')as f:subprocess.run(['python3',str(s/'accept_tail_prefix.py'),'replay'],cwd=r,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
 phase('replay_complete_pending_record')
except Exception as error:phase('failure',error=str(error));raise
